n = int(input())
b = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
costs = [-1] * n

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i != n - 1:
        costs[i] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i])
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

costs = sorted(costs)
totalCost = 0
cuts = 0

for c in costs:
    if c != -1:
        totalCost += c
        if totalCost > b:
            break
        cuts += 1

print(cuts)
</translated_code>
